```plato

//==
// # Numeric tuples
//
// The low-level intrinsic tier of the IVector family: fixed-arity tuples of
// Numbers with component-wise arithmetic, mapped directly onto each backend's
// native vector type (System.Numerics, vecN, floatN). Naming rule: a bare number
// counts components (Number3, Tuple3, IntegerVector3); a D suffix means the type
// lives in that-dimensional space (Vector3D, Point3D, Ray3D).
//
// Discoverability: the concrete per-component operations for
// Number2/3/4/8 — Normalize, Dot, Length/LengthSquared,
// Add/Subtract/Multiply/Divide, Transform — are declared on the intrinsic hub in
// `intrinsics.library.plato`, not restated here.

// A pair of Numbers: the low-level intrinsic 2-tuple.
type Number2
    implements IVector
{
    X: Number;
    Y: Number;
}
```
